headline.current: Therapy for what you've been carrying alone
headline.refined: You don't have to carry this alone
headline.analysis: More active. 'You' = agency. Shorter. Reverses negative frame.

subheadline.current: I specialize in what feels stuck: perinatal anxiety, adult ADHD diagnosis, and career crossroads
subheadline.refined: Perinatal anxiety. Late ADHD. Career doubt. These require understanding—and you'll get it here.
subheadline.analysis: Active voice. Specific conditions (power words). Promise clarity. '—and you'll get it here' creates action.

descriptor.current: Trauma-informed, culturally humble, and practical. I specialize in what feels stuck—and help you find clarity, belonging, and your own answers.
descriptor.refined: I meet you where you are. We work at your pace. You'll find your answers—not mine.
descriptor.analysis: Shows method (not jargon). Active verbs. 'Your answers—not mine' affirms autonomy. Remove 'trauma-informed' buzzword.

persona_prompt.current: Which applies to you? (You might see yourself in more than one—that's exactly why I specialize in what feels stuck.)
persona_prompt.refined: Which one resonates? (Many of you see yourselves in multiple—and that's the work we do.)
persona_prompt.analysis: Remove redundant 'what feels stuck.' 'Resonates' is warmer than 'applies.' 'The work we do' = action-oriented.

fear_reduction.current: Whether you've been in therapy before or this is your first time—there's no judgment here. You're not broken for reaching out. You're taking care of yourself.
fear_reduction.refined: First time or returning: you belong here. Seeking help isn't weakness—it's wisdom.
fear_reduction.analysis: Direct address of fear. Remove 'broken' double-negative. 'Wisdom' affirms strength. Power verb: 'Seeking' vs 'taking care of.'

first_session.current: Your first session: a conversation where you share what brought you here at your own pace. I listen, and we see if we're a good fit. You're in control.
first_session.refined: First session: you talk, I listen. We'll know within 15 minutes if we fit. You lead the pace.
first_session.analysis: Active. Specific timeline removes anxiety. 'You lead' > 'You're in control' (shorter, clearer).

current: Respond within 24 hours • Usually available within 1-2 weeks
trust_signals.analysis: Remove 'Usually' (erodes trust). Remove 'Respond within 24 hours' redundancy. 'I respond' > passive. 'Book within' is concrete.

cta_primary.analysis: Shorter. 'Your' adds ownership. '15-Minute' is implicit in booking flow.

cta_secondary.analysis: 'Learn' is active. 'Approach' is more specific than 'how I work.'
